text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the race behind us, it's back to<n>summer camp,
and Shinko Windy is<n>leaping straight back into the
daily<n>training grind.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hiyeeeaaah! Trainer! I wanna do one<n>more rep!
More running! MORE!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Why the heck wouldn't I be?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
In my next race, I'm gonna have<n>every pair of eyes
in the whole venue<n>glued to me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Training is going smoothly, and she's<n>growing
stronger by the day. It won't<n>be long until her
ambition is in reach.
choice_data_list: All right, let's do our best!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Pant... Nothing seems to be working...Am I... getting any stronger?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Rwaaaar! I got more left in me! One<n>more gooo!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...! I know that voice...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...Windy!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Agh? Got somethin' to say, Biko?<n>Itchin' to get
pranked, hm?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I... watched the Japan Dirt Derby, you<n>know!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...You were cool, bold, and<n>intimidating... And you ran
with style.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Heh-heh!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Pwffff! AWWWW YEAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hmph, it's no big deal.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
It just feels epic to see Biko shakin'<n>in her cleats,
that's all. ♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I'm not "shaking." I... I just have a lot<n>on my mind
lately.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Um... Windy, can I ask you<n>something?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Where do you find the strength to<n>push yourself so
hard?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I haven't tasted victory in so long...<n>And it's been
getting to me...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
But you're not just fighting to<n>win—you're also
fighting for your<n>reputation!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
You probably have it so much worse<n>than me, yet
you never let it show. In<n>fact, you just keep getting
faster and<n>stronger every day!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: How do you push yourself that hard?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: You're tellin' me that's what's onyour mind?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
First of all, wipe those tears, and<n>clean the snot
dripping from your<n>nose.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: What?! I'm not c-crying or anythi...Sniff... Hic!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Here's what I'll tell ya. The way<n>things are now,
I'd be ticked off if<n>they never change.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ticked off?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: You heard me! Ticked off! Super<n>annoyed!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
If I gave up now, the world would<n>remember me as
nothin' but the ugly<n>Umamusume who bites
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
So listen up. If you stop now,<n>nothing's ever gonna
get better, ever!<n>Your chances are a big, fat zero!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
But what if... nothing changes even if<n>you keep
going? No matter what you<n>do or how many races
you win?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
What's the point in askin' that before<n>you even
try?! I say worry 'bout that<n>when and if it comes
up!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
In my case, the job's not done, so<n>I'm givin' it my
all till it is!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: You're... You're right.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: If I were... to give up now, I'd be aloser for life.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! You'll be a loser forever!<n>And I dunno
about you, but I for one<n>don't plan on goin' out like
that!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: After all, I've got ambition!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's right... She has fiery ambition<n>burning in her
heart...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Lemme promise you this...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'll become an Umamusume strong<n>enough to top
the rankings even a<n>hundred years from now!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: That's gonna be me! Just you watch!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...And that's the long and short of it!<n>Pretty cool, eh?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
So that's what makes you able to<n>endure
everything...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Haha... It is pretty cool.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: So... Yeah, I... I won't let it end like<n>this, either!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Thanks... both of you! I think you've<n>reignited my
fire!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hmph. Finally got your swagger<n>back?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'm good to go now! I... don't<n>wanna lose
anymore—especially not<n>against you, Windy!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
What's that?! And here I thought you<n>were down in
the dumps!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Haha! I'll take you on in some<n>training right now!
How about it?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Lackey! How're we gonna<n>settle this? Make
it somethin' quick<n>so we're back in time for dinner.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Let me see...
choice_data_list: Test your power with sumo wrestling!
Put your guts to the test with squats!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Bono has trained me well in sumo! So<n>I have the
edge!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Oh? Big talk from a half-pint! Size is<n>king in sumo.

text_block_list.name: Windy and Biko
text_block_list.text: GRAAAAAH! HIYAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Their forceful grunts echo into the<n>evening sky. Not
satisfied with a<n>single round, Shinko Windy insists
on<n>battling it out until the very moment<n>dinner is
served.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I can squat till sundown, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Windy and Biko
text_block_list.text: Huff! Huff! Pant! Pant!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: N-not yet... We go till somebody<n>drops!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I eventually convince them to call it a<n>draw before
the camp cafeteria<n>closes for the night.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ngh... Why can't you admit... when<n>you've lost?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hmph! I don't stop 'til I win! And<n>that's that!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heehee... In the end, Windy always<n>gets the last
laugh. ♪

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: It's about time for me to catch some<n>Z's. I'm out!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Yeesh... She really doesn't give in.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
It'd be one thing if we were racing,<n>but this was
just training.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Is she like this all because of that<n>biting incident?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I mean—I totally get it, biting people'sa big no-no, but... it's amazing howshe's flipped that into being hermotivation.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I don't think I would've had the<n>strength to turn
myself around like<n>that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Another day of summer camp comes<n>to a close. I
wonder how their<n>opinions have changed now that
they<n>have a deeper understanding of each<n>other.
